sections.en: Meaning they say that the degree of the Moon is the planet of exaltation, the degree of its exaltation is at that time when the body of the planet falls in the middle of the exaltation. Morning rising and evening setting in the superior planets, according to the majority, is sixty degrees. And if it passes that and is in morning rising, not evening setting, but Ptolemy [says] the morning rising and evening setting of the superior planets is the maximum amount of their distance from the Sun, which is more than sixty degrees. All the wandering planets, whenever they are under the rays, the arc of their morning rising and evening setting is sixty degrees. The Persians in this drive and descend. The planet being right-handed is like a person who has strength in his right hand, and the planet being left-handed is like one who has strength in his left hand. 12

summary.headline: Astrological Strength Rankings
summary.text: Astrological strength rankings distinguish highest, middle, and lowest categories, including direct motion, speed, benefic terms and triplicity, latitude, light and magnitude, faces, ninths and twelfths, houses, assistance, bounty, and recompense. Examples explain Mars assisting the Sun in Aries and define planetary motion, enclosure, diurnal/nocturnal condition, and right- and left-handed planets, with Ptolemy cited on planetary rising and setting.
